nodes.title: Setup and model downloads
widgets_values:
## LTX 2.5 DFR detail workflow

1. Accept the LTX 2.5 license and download the split components.
2. Convert the development transformer to Q8 pages with `scripts/convert_ltx25_paged_q8.py`.
3. Bake the rank-450 adapter into stage-one pages with `scripts/fuse_ltx25_paged_lora.py`.
4. Bake the rank-450 and Pixel-Spatial adapters together into separate stage-two pages.
5. Put the Diffusion VAE in `ComfyUI/models/vae/`.
6. Run Preflight before generation.
7. Queue the workflow after Preflight succeeds.

Build both derived checkpoints from the original Q8 pages. Do not fuse stage two from the stage-one result because sequential requantization changes video output. Preflight verifies the adapter hashes. The optimized path preserves decoded video and audio exactly relative to live Q8 LoRA fusion while removing repeated fusion from every transformer evaluation. DFR performs a generative full-resolution detail pass and keeps stage-one audio. It can change composition and motion. The Diffusion VAE improves the final pixel decode but is much slower than the Conv VAE.

### Downloads

- [LTX 2.5 development transformer, distilled LoRA, and components](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5)
- [Pixel-Spatial IC-LoRA](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Pixel-Spatial-Upscaler)
